scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10 --outDir dist/cjs --declaration false --declarationMap false && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
